title: Central Council Advice on Consumer Rights

content.scenario: A state government seeks advice from the Central Council on how to promote and protect consumer rights in their region.
content.outcome: The Central Council shall render advice on the promotion and protection of consumers' rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, to help the state government develop effective consumer protection policies.

user_queries: What is the role of the Central Council in promoting consumer rights?
How does the Central Council advise on consumer protection?
What are the objectives of the Central Council under the CPA 2019?
